title: Budget fiction shelf
prompt: The shop is setting up a budget fiction shelf. Show the id of every book that is in the Fiction genre and also costs less than 14.
hints: AND requires both conditions to be true.

cases.name: A different catalogue
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (20, 'Ember Bay', 'Ann Cho', 'Fiction', 11.0, 150, 2017), (21, 'Long Tide', 'Sol Ruiz', 'Poetry', 12.0, 90, 2019), (22, 'Old Maps', 'Ken Ito', 'Fiction', 16.0, 205, 2020), (24, 'Grey Wren', 'Ann Cho', 'Fiction', 14.0, 111, 2022);

solutions: SELECT id FROM books WHERE genre = 'Fiction' AND price < 14;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT id FROM books WHERE genre = 'Fiction' OR price < 14;
wrongSolutions.why: OR accepts a book meeting just one condition

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT id FROM books WHERE genre = 'Fiction' AND price <= 14;
SELECT title FROM books WHERE genre = 'Fiction' AND price < 14;
wrongSolutions.why: Returns the title instead of the id

title: Not invited by nova
prompt: Nova is user 1. Show the username of every user who wasn't invited by nova, including users nobody invited.
solutions: SELECT username FROM users WHERE referrer_id <> 1 OR referrer_id IS NULL;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT username FROM users WHERE referrer_id <> 1;
SELECT username FROM users WHERE referrer_id IS NULL;
wrongSolutions.why: Keeps only users with no referrer

title: Extreme readings
prompt: A reading is extreme if it's at least 25 degrees or has at least 4 mm of rain. Show the city, reading_date, and temp_c of extreme readings.
solutions: SELECT city, reading_date, temp_c FROM readings WHERE temp_c >= 25 OR rainfall_mm >= 4;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT city, reading_date, temp_c FROM readings WHERE temp_c >= 25 AND rainfall_mm >= 4;
SELECT city, reading_date, temp_c FROM readings WHERE temp_c > 25 OR rainfall_mm > 4;

title: Courses taken twice
prompt: A retake is an enrolment with a grade below 60. Show each different student_id with a retake-level grade, sorted by student_id, in a column named id.
hints: Filter, remove duplicates, rename, and sort.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM enrolments; DELETE FROM courses; DELETE FROM students; INSERT INTO students VALUES (6, 'Femi', 9), (7, 'Gia', 9), (8, 'Hao', 10); INSERT INTO courses VALUES (5, 'Chemistry', 'Science'), (6, 'Drama', 'Arts'); INSERT INTO enrolments VALUES (11, 6, 5, 60, '2023-autumn'), (12, 6, 5, 60, '2024-spring'), (13, 7, 5, NULL, '2024-spring'), (14, 7, 6, 95, '2024-spring');

solutions: SELECT DISTINCT student_id AS id FROM enrolments WHERE grade < 60 ORDER BY id;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT student_id AS id FROM enrolments WHERE grade <= 60 ORDER BY id;
wrongSolutions.why: A grade of exactly 60 isn't below 60

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM enrolments WHERE grade < 60 ORDER BY student_id;
